name: Wisdom - Work Intelligence & Secure Data Operations Manager
description: Multi-tenant, theme-based SaaS for work intelligence and secure data operations: mortgage and job tracking with FastAPI, MongoDB, React SPA, per-tenant branding, and container-first deployment.
longDescription: Wisdom (Work Intelligence & Secure Data Operations Manager) is a multi-tenant, theme-based platform for tracking client jobs, banks, documents, and teams with strict company-level data boundaries and per-tenant UI theming. A FastAPI backend on MongoDB exposes a documented REST API with JWT authentication and role-based access. A React SPA delivers the main product experience with company-scoped theme configuration; an optional Tauri desktop client reuses the same API. Background workers process mortgage document extraction with Redis-backed job queues for reliable, scalable workloads. Deployed with Docker or Podman Compose, container registry images, and CI pipelines that build and verify releases.
features: Multi-tenant API with company-scoped data, RBAC, and per-tenant theme configuration
React SPA with production build and environment-aware configuration
Document intelligence pipeline for regulated mortgage paperwork
Redis-backed worker queues with scaling and recovery patterns
Optional Tauri desktop client sharing the web API contract
Compose-based dev, staging, and production topologies
CI release images and operational runbooks for deployment
highlights: Tenant-safe architecture with document intelligence alongside core CRM flows
Container-native delivery with repeatable registry-based deploys
Web and desktop clients on one stable API contract
challenges: Multi-tenant products need clear access control, observable workers, and safe secret handling across environments.
solutions: Documented security model, separated compose profiles, health and metrics endpoints, and automated CI builds before promotion to production.
security: Documented security architecture and incident response practices
Secrets managed outside source control in deployment environments
Rootless container guidance for production hosts
